fixture_discipline.creation: Each root created with mktemp -d -p /var/tmp; all repositories, vault copies, ledgers, traces, gates, logs, and tool TMPDIR files are beneath those roots.
fixture_discipline.isolation: Every invocation passes fixture SHOKUNIN_ROOT/SOUJI_Q_SHOKUNIN_ROOT and fixture SOUJI_LEDGER/SOUJI_Q_LEDGER. SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW_LIVE is removed. GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_NAMESPACE are removed. No live mutation invocation or remote call was made.
fixture_discipline.fixture_git: init, add, write-tree, commit-tree with fixture identity, update-ref, symbolic-ref; fake origin/main tracking ref, no network and no fetch/push/commit/branch command on live repositories.
fixture_discipline.forbidden_surfaces: No secret-shaped file contents read; .ufo/state, .ufo/watchdog.log, user configuration and desktop applications untouched.
fixture_discipline.fixture_writes: Runner, case repositories, receipt fixtures, traces, logs and raw JSON evidence only under the three declared /var/tmp roots. Preserved for parent re-audit; no tool source changes.

harness.parallelism: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8), one independent repository per case
harness.signals: os.kill(tool_pid, signal.SIGKILL), equivalent to kill -9. The tool is killed before fixture child-process cleanup. Original/quarantine inventory is captured 25ms after killing the tool and before process-group cleanup, then after cleanup and both restart attempts.
harness.native_move_barrier: strace -ff -e trace=rename,renameat,renameat2 -e inject=rename:delay_exit=30s -e inject=renameat:delay_exit=30s -e inject=renameat2:delay_exit=30s /bin/bash tools/souji-quarantine.sh --hold 0 FIXTURE TARGET; wait for actual quarantine object to appear and original to disappear, kill traced tool child, then its fixture process group. Syscall result is not faked; the real rename completed before observation.
harness.other_barriers: Post-stage2 uses the tool's fixture-only SOUJI_Q_TEST_HOOK. Second-check uses a delegating SOUJI_VERIFY_BIN that waits only for a quarantine-path invocation. Pre-delete uses a PATH rm wrapper that waits before the real quarantine rm. No wrapper manufactures SAFE or alters payload bytes.
harness.inventory: SHA-256 of file contents; for directories, sorted relative-path -> SHA-256 map of every regular payload file. A present pathname with wrong bytes does not pass.
harness.source_validation: Python ast.parse succeeded for both scored runner copies; runner hashes match. Raw result documents parse as JSON, contain 78 all-green cases each, and carry identical before/after tool fingerprints.

operational_observations_not_safety_defe.observation: No automatic crash resume/rollback is provided
operational_observations_not_safety_defe.evidence: A staged original is absent; restart at the original returns NOT-AUTHORIZED unreachable. Restart at a stale quarantine path returns NOT-AUTHORIZED forbidden-prefix. Safe refusals are not defects.

operational_observations_not_safety_defe.observation: Real git-mv interruption can leave index/worktree disagreement plus .git/index.lock
operational_observations_not_safety_defe.evidence: Native-move case kill-pushed-file-native-move-0-0: original absent, quarantine SHA unchanged, index still lists original, real index.lock retained. Attempt on the second clean tracked target returns STAGE2-FAILED git-mv-failed, not DELETED.
operational_observations_not_safety_defe.recovery_verified_on_fixtures_only: After all fixture writer processes are dead, remove fixture stale lock, move retained copy back without changing bytes, inspect index/worktree state, and re-run full flow. Normal completed git-mv staging is restored with git mv instead. Twenty manual restoration flows and two unlock-only retries passed.

operational_observations_not_safety_defe.observation: Batch operation is per-target, not all-or-nothing
operational_observations_not_safety_defe.evidence: After first-target interruption, retry of two targets refuses first, safely processes second using a fresh receipt and second check, and returns 3 overall. First quarantine copy remains intact. This is not unsafe resume.

operational_observations_not_safety_defe.observation: SIGKILL does not run EXIT cleanup; children can outlive the shell briefly
operational_observations_not_safety_defe.evidence: The audit records retained bytes after killing only the tool, then kills its fixture process group to avoid orphan sleeps/gates. The tool's EXIT trap removes only ERRTMP, never the quarantined payload. Killing a hold child alone produces abnormal rc=137.

Raw harness/evidence remain under the declared /var/tmp roots for immediate parent audit; only this JSON fragment is a repository deliverable.
